olivia.sales: Customer (FinEdge) wants a short POC for customer-managed keys. Main asks: on-site key hand-off option, attestation artifacts we produce, and an itemized HSM operations line on the quote. Can we align?

raj.solutions: Quick scope q: do they need HSM-originated CMKs (never exportable) or support import-wrapped keys? Also ask if they require multi-region replication or a single-region proof-of-concept.

toni.eng: Both supported. For a minimal POC I suggest: HSM-originated master key, 2-of-3 physical custodians (we can provide an on-site tech if they want), single region to keep latency consistent. Perf hit: ~4ms median on encrypt path when using remote HSM RPC.

nate.security: From security side: we must provide an HSM attestation bundle (manufacturer certs + firmware sigs) and an HSM-generated key fingerprint. We will NOT accept unprotected private key export. Recommended algorithms: AES-256-KW for wrapping or RSA-OAEP-256. Rotation policy: support customer-triggered rotation; suggested window 02:00-03:00 local, 30-60m maintenance SLA.

claudia.ps: Pricing: line items to include on the quote: 
- HSM-POC-Appliance (7-day rental)
- On-site technician (day rate) if they want hand-off
- One-time BYOK onboarding fee
- Optional multi-AZ replication surcharge
I'll attach a sample billing snippet to the SOW.

olivia.sales: Legal flags? Need to give them something to send to their legal/security team.

nate.security: Legal/LDR notes: include an encryption appendix in the contract referencing BYOK controls, non-export guarantee for HSM-generated keys, and our audit log export SLA (we can stream audit events to customer SIEM for 90 days). Also confirm we can provide eDiscovery metadata but not plaintext keys.

toni.eng: Implementation notes for the POC API (customer import case):
```
PUT /v1/customer_keys/{cust_id}/import
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "key_blob":"base64(...)",
  "wrap_alg":"AES-256-KW",
  "metadata":{
    "custodian_ids":["CUSTA","CUSTB","CUSTC"]
  }
}
```
Response includes import_status and key_fingerprint. (If HSM-originated, client receives only thumbprint.)

raj.solutions: Operational preflight checklist I'll send: network ranges for HSM appliance, port 443/8443 allowed, NTP sync, custodian identity forms, and PKI chain for attestation verification. Lead time estimate: 7 business days to provision appliance + 2-3 days for on-site scheduling.

claudia.ps: For the quote, tentative SKU codes: POC-HSM-7D, ON-SITE-TECH-DAY, BYOK-ONBOARD. If they want escrow, that's an additional legal-approved addendum.

incident-bot: Reminder: Preflight questionnaire due in 48h to avoid delay. (link: forms.example.com/finedge-preflight)

olivia.sales: Great. Next actions: @raj.solutions drop the checklist + attestation example to this thread by EOD. @nate.security upload the attestation bundle template and exact log export retention lines. @claudia.ps please draft the quote lines so I can attach to the SOW. I'll book a 30m sync with the customer for Tuesday.

raj.solutions: Will do  I'll include examples of cert chain and expected attestation file names (manufacturer.cer, firmware.sig, hsm-serial.txt).

nate.security: I'll include the minimum legal wording for BYOK in the thread.

olivia.sales: Thanks team, keeping this thread as the source of truth for the POC runbook and quote items.
